steps.description: Planning loop re-searches the return corridor for the requested departure date (REPLAY evidence) and records the stay extension honestly

assert.description: the planner requests return-corridor evidence first, then proposes from it
the evidence request is a flight search on the return corridor
the REPLAY recording supplied return-corridor offers
every normalized corridor offer becomes a candidate rebook strategy
the candidate rebooks the existing return leg to a later departure
a Sunday return inside the trip window is deterministically feasible
the strategy carries a deterministic gross price from REPLAY evidence
feasible candidates are ranked into a best strategy
the stay extension is recorded honestly, not silently dropped

assert.expected: stayCheckOut requested: stay-date replanning is not supported by this planner yet
assert.description: the planner records the unsupported stay replanning as an explicit uncertainty
the case advanced through the planning stage

steps.description: Strategy becomes a money-moving intent; deterministic authority decides and the real price is allocated against the funded window

assert.description: the priced cost accrues outside the funded window and is allocated in full as incremental
mixed funding: the incremental payer derives deterministically from the funding-window rule
the allocation cites the governing policy rule
the allocation is surfaced as a human-readable deterministic summary
the per-trip airfare ceiling is evaluated against the gross spend
the accommodation ceiling participates in the same deterministic review
the gross spend beyond a declared policy ceiling never executes: authority fails closed
a blocked money-moving intent escalates the case for human review
no executor can pick up the intent while authority blocks it
the case belongs to the requesting traveller's trip
